questions.question: What was India’s rank in the Global Peace Index 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**115th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **In the Global Peace Index 2025__, India was ranked __115th__ out of 163 countries, with a peace score of __2.229__, unchanged from 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s peace score remained stable at 2.229__, reflecting ongoing internal security challenges, border tensions, and urban safety concerns.**
 
• **India ranks __115th__, indicating challenges in maintaining national peace and stability compared to other nations.**
 
• **Factors influencing India’s rank include __internal security issues__, __border conflicts__, and varying effectiveness of law enforcement.**
 
• **India’s performance aligns with broader geopolitical and security dynamics, influencing its overall peace score.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Global Peace Index**__

 __
 
• Measured on 23 indicators__ like societal safety, ongoing conflict, and degree of militarisation.
 
• A __lower score__ indicates a higher level of peace, with Iceland ranking as the most peaceful country in the world with a score of __1.095__.
 
 
 
• __**Factors Affecting India’s Rank**__
 __
 
• Internal Security Challenges__: Including insurgencies and localised conflicts.
 
• __Border Tensions__: Persistent tensions with neighbouring countries impacting peace.
 
• __Urban Safety Concerns__: Crime rates and law enforcement issues in cities.

questions.question: Which world’s first Digital Tribal University was launched by Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Durgadas Uikey in New Delhi?

__
 
• **Adi Sanskriti is a digital academy and e-learning platform designed to promote tribal art, culture, crafts, and knowledge systems to a global audience.**

questions.question: Which state in India achieved a literacy rate of 99.30%, becoming fully literate as declared on International Literacy Day 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh was declared fully literate by its Chief Minister on International Literacy Day, achieving a 99.30% literacy rate, surpassing the national average of 95%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh became the fourth state, after Tripura, Mizoram, and Goa, to achieve full functional literacy.**
 
• Ladakh is the first fully literate Union Territory of India.
 
• India's national literacy rate rose from 74% in 2011 to 80.9% in 2023–24.
 
• The ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram enrolled over 3 crore learners with a 90% success rate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram__

 __
 
• A national literacy initiative aimed at promoting education and increasing literacy across India with over 3 crore learners enrolled.
 
 
 
• International Literacy Day (ILD)__
 __
 
• Observed annually on September 8, ILD highlights the importance of literacy, with a focus on different themes, such as "Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era" in 2025.
 
 
 
• India's Literacy Growth__
 
 
• The literacy rate in India has risen significantly, from 74% in 2011 to 80.9% in 2023–24, showing continued progress in national education efforts.

questions.question: Which two institutions have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to integrate science and innovation into sports performance in India?

options.text: Sports Authority of India (SAI) and IIT Delhi
National Sports Federation and IIT Bombay
Ministry of Sports and IIT Delhi
Sports Authority of India (SAI) and IIT Kanpur

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sports Authority of India (SAI) and IIT Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Sports Authority of India’s National Centre of Sports Science Research (SAI-NCSSR) has entered into an MoU with IIT Delhi to integrate science and innovation into sports performance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The MoU aims to align cutting-edge science and indigenous innovation with the government's Atmanirbhar Bharat and Garv se Swadeshi visions for enhancing sports performance.**
 
• Along with the MoU, a state-of-the-art Biomechanics Laboratory was inaugurated at IIT Delhi to support the initiative.
 
• The partnership emphasizes the role of scientific research in improving athletic performance and fostering innovation in sports in India.
 
• This collaboration is a significant step in India’s sports science and innovation landscape, promoting self-reliance and global competitiveness in sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Atmanirbhar Bharat__

 __
 
• A vision for India to become self-reliant, emphasizing indigenous solutions in various sectors, including sports science.
 
 
 
• Garv se Swadeshi__
 __
 
• An initiative to encourage pride in using indigenous products and innovations, reflecting India’s growing capabilities in sports and other domains.
 
 
 
• Biomechanics Laboratory__
 
 
• A state-of-the-art lab inaugurated at IIT Delhi to study the mechanical principles of human movement, crucial for enhancing sports performance.

questions.question: How many years in prison was former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro sentenced to by Brazil’s Supreme Court over his involvement in a coup plot?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**27 years and 3 months.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Brazil’s Supreme Court sentenced former President Jair Bolsonaro__ to __27 years and 3 months in prison__ for plotting a coup to remain in power after losing the 2022 election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bolsonaro was convicted on five charges__, including leading a criminal organisation and attempting to abolish democracy.**
 
• Four of the five justices on the Supreme Court panel voted to convict him.
 
• Justice Carmen Lucia said he acted with the intent to __erode democracy and institutions__.
 
• Bolsonaro is currently __under house arrest__ and his lawyers have said they will appeal the verdict.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Jair Bolsonaro__

 __
 
• Former President of Brazil (2019–2022)
 
• Lost 2022 election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
 
• Barred from contesting elections until 2030 by Brazil’s top electoral court
 
 
 
• Charges Faced__
 __
 
• Leading a criminal organisation
 
• Attempting to violently abolish democracy
 
• Organising a coup and damaging government property
 
 
 
• Legal Proceedings__
 
 
• Faced up to 40 years in prison
 
• Justice Luiz Fux was the only judge who voted to acquit him
 
• Bolsonaro’s defense plans to appeal nationally and internationally

questions.question: Which Indian Naval Ship participated in the 50th Independence Day celebrations of Papua New Guinea and took part in the Military Tattoo at Port Moresby in September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Kadmatt.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **INS Kadmatt participated in Papua New Guinea’s 50th Independence Day celebrations, with the Indian Navy Band performing at the grand Military Tattoo in Port Moresby.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Navy Band performed martial tunes and Indian melodies, showcasing India’s cultural ethos.**
 
• The event brought together bands from several nations, symbolising unity and shared heritage.
 
• INS Kadmatt’s crew also paid homage at Bomana War Cemetery, honouring WWII heroes, including Indian soldiers.
 
• The visit highlighted maritime bonds and India’s commitment to friendship with Pacific nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INS Vikrant__

 __
 
• India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier, commissioned in September 2022.
 
• Symbol of India’s naval self-reliance.
 
 
 
• INS Kolkata__
 __
 
• Lead ship of the Kolkata-class stealth guided-missile destroyers.
 
• Commissioned in 2014, based at Mumbai under Western Naval Command.
 
 
 
• INS Shivalik__
 __
 
• India’s first indigenously built stealth multi-role frigate.
 
• Commissioned in 2010 and part of the Eastern Naval Command.
 
 
 
• INS Kadmatt__
 
 
• Second ship of the Kamorta-class anti-submarine warfare corvettes.
 
• Commissioned in January 2016, named after Kadmat Island in Lakshadweep.
 
• Played a key role in strengthening maritime diplomacy through cultural and ceremonial engagements.

questions.question: Which country has recently banned 26 major social media platforms, including Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, WhatsApp, and Snapchat, for failing to register with the government?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nepal has ordered ISPs to block 26 major social media and communication platforms, including Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, X, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ban was enforced after platforms failed to register with the government within the seven-day deadline.**
 
• **The move follows a Supreme Court directive to regulate online platforms and monitor unwanted content.**
 
• **The government’s directive requires platforms to register, appoint a compliance officer, and set up complaint mechanisms.**
 
• **Some platforms like TikTok, Viber, and Telegram remain operational as they complied or are in process of registering.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Directive on Regulating the Use of Social Media, 2080__

 __
 
• Mandates registration of both domestic and foreign social media platforms.
 
• Requires a local contact person and compliance officer in Nepal.
 
• Ensures mechanisms to address local complaints about online content.
 
 
 
• Criticism__
 
 
• Rights groups view the ban as censorship and a threat to freedom of expression.
 
• Concerns raised over a proposed social media bill that could impose fines or jail for content against "national interest".

questions.question: According to the Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) Feasibility Study released by the Ministry of Civil Aviation, what blending target has India set for SAF by 2030?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**5%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Civil Aviation, in partnership with ICAO and with support from the European Union, released the Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) Feasibility Study for India.**
 
• **India has set SAF blending targets of 1% by 2027, 2% by 2028, and 5% by 2030.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) is an alternative to petroleum-based jet fuel, produced from non-petroleum feedstocks.**
 
• **India aims to align SAF targets with ICAO’s CORSIA mandate for reducing aviation emissions.**
 
• **100% SAF has the potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 94%, depending on feedstock and technology pathway.**
 
• **India, the world’s third-largest aviation market, is expected to double passenger traffic to 500 million by 2030, making SAF adoption crucial.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About CORSIA**__

 __
 
• Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) caps net CO2 emissions at 2020 levels until 2035.
 
• Aims to help achieve the aviation industry’s goal of net zero carbon emissions by 2050.
 
 
 
• **SAF Blending and Usage**__
 __
 
• SAF can be blended with Jet A fuel, with blending limits ranging from 10% to 50% depending on production pathways.
 
• Compatible with existing aircraft engines and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Global Context**__
 __
 
• Aviation contributes 2% of global CO2 emissions and 12% of transportation-related CO2 emissions.
 
• SAF is the best near-term solution for emission reduction in aviation.
 
 
 
• **India’s Readiness**__
 
 
• India is targeting phased blending of SAF—1% by 2027, 2% by 2028, and 5% by 2030.
 
• This aligns with India’s vision to become the world’s largest domestic aviation market.

questions.question: Under which theme was World Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Day observed on 7th September 2025?

questions.question: At the age of 102, who became the oldest man to summit Mount Fuji, Japan’s tallest peak, on August 5, 2025, setting a new Guinness World Record?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kokichi Akuzawa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kokichi Akuzawa, aged 102, became the oldest man to summit Mount Fuji, setting a new Guinness World Record on August 5, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kokichi Akuzawa, a seasoned mountaineer, overcame multiple health setbacks to achieve this remarkable feat.**
 
• **The summit of Mount Fuji is at 3,776 meters, and Akuzawa’s climb, completed with his family, became an inspiration to many.**
 
• **Akuzawa trained for three months leading up to the climb, engaging in daily walks and climbing mountains weekly.**
 
• **This climb marked his second attempt at the record, having previously set the title at age 96 before surpassing it at 102.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mount Fuji__

 __
 
• Mount Fuji is Japan's highest peak, standing at 3,776 meters, and is considered an iconic symbol of the country.

questions.question: From October 1,2025 SEBI’s new framework caps the net intraday position in equity index options at what limit per entity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**5,000 crore rupees.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has introduced a new monitoring framework for intraday positions in equity index derivatives.**
 
• **Effective from October 1, the net intraday position is capped at 5,000 crore rupees per entity in index options.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Net intraday cap: 5,000 crore rupees per entity in index options.**
 
• **Earlier end-of-day position limit: 1,500 crore rupees.**
 
• **Gross intraday limit remains unchanged at 10,000 crore rupees.**
 
• **SEBI aims to curb excessive risk-taking and strengthen market stability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Monitoring Mechanism**__

 __
 
• Stock exchanges will track intraday positions using at least four random snapshots daily.
 
• One snapshot must be taken during peak market hours (2:45 pm to 3:30 pm).
 
 
 
• **Compliance Measures**__
 __
 
• Breaches will lead to scrutiny, penalties, or additional surveillance deposits.
 
 
 
• **Objective**__
 __
 
• Enhance oversight of large exposures in equity index derivatives.
 
• Ensure orderly market functioning and reduce systemic risks.
 
 
 
• **Background**__
 
 
• SEBI is India’s securities market regulator, ensuring transparency, investor protection, and fair practices.

questions.question: According to the Air Quality Life Index (AQLI), which country is ranked as the second most polluted in the world?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

__
 
• **India has the second-highest level of air pollution globally, reducing life expectancy by an average of 3.5 years due to severe air quality issues.**
 
• The AQLI is developed by Professor Michael Greenstone and the Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago (EPIC), offering hyper-local data on the impact of air pollution on life expectancy.
 
• **South Asia, including India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Pakistan, remains the most polluted region in the world.**
 
• The report emphasizes the urgent need for evidence-based policies to reduce air pollution and improve public health.
 
• India’s air pollution level significantly impacts life expectancy, with some regions like Northern India losing up to 8.2 years of life due to severe air quality degradation.

• __China:__ Has made significant progress in reducing pollution by 40.8% since 2014 through aggressive policies like cleaner heating and traffic restrictions.

questions.question: Which two dairy products have been completely exempted from GST under the government’s recent GST reforms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Milk and Paneer.**__

__
 
• **The Centre’s GST reforms provided direct relief in the dairy sector by exempting Milk and Paneer, whether branded or unbranded, from GST.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milk and Paneer are now GST-free, lowering household costs and improving nutrition security.**
 
• **Over 10 crore dairy farmers will directly benefit from these exemptions.**
 
• **Women-led rural enterprises and cooperatives engaged in dairy processing gain competitiveness.**
 
• **Other dairy items like Butter and Ghee had their GST reduced to 5%, but were not fully exempted.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Butter & Ghee__

 __
 
• GST reduced from 12% to 5%.
 
• Improves affordability and supports dairy cooperatives.
 
 
 
• Cheese & Other Foods__
 __
 
• Cheese, pasta, namkeens, jams, jellies, and juice-based drinks now taxed at 5%.
 
• Aims to reduce household expenditure and encourage food processing growth.
 
 
 
• Farm Inputs__
 __
 
• Fertiliser inputs like ammonia, sulphuric acid, and nitric acid GST cut to 5%.
 
• Bio-pesticides and micronutrients also reduced to 5%, encouraging organic farming.
 
 
 
• Logistics__
 
 
• Trucks and delivery vans GST reduced to 18% from 28%.
 
• Third-party insurance of goods carriage reduced to 5% with ITC, easing logistics costs.
